agent.oc.notes: Onion AI Agent Console — brain-proposed tasks via the Bridge agent layer; web_search runs server-side, machine actions (bash/file) park at awaiting_approval for human approval, then dispatch to the Cloud PC agentrun service. Self-tune rules are proposals until approved.

bots.oc.notes: Bot Forge — admin-only bot-making workshop (website + engine)

breach.oc.notes: Onion Core Breach Check — password (HIBP k-anonymity) + email (XposedOrNot) lookup against known breaches; watchlist on-device only

builder.oc.notes: Onion Core Website Builder — the front door for getting a site built

chat.oc.notes: Onion Core Room Chat — code-word rooms, MQTT/WSS relay, client-side encrypted, no history
